description: Use when the question is specifically whether OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google or Apple bots may access a site. Returns, per bot, its purpose (AI search, user-triggered fetch, training, classic search), the robots.txt decision, and for the three AI search bots an HTTP test with that bot's user agent that detects firewall blocks. Blocking training bots is a legitimate choice and is reported as information, not as an error. Fetches up to 5 URLs.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, for example https://example.com

name: check_ai_crawlers
title: Check which AI crawlers can reach a site
